result_text:
I fixed the default scoping conventions so the intended `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` and `-gradle.js` files now match. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes (335 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped), and the new regression test passes (5/5). Nothing is committed.

All changes are in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (three rules, pkgdown/Doxygen/meta generator):** the path pattern `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)` is now `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`. The duplicated `html` was a typo, so `.htm` was added in its place.
- **.NET assembly docs (`<doc>` XML):** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** the path pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. The content check still decides which files are caught.
- **Gradle JavaScript (build-and-deployment):** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the fixed `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` and `build-gradle.js` files are caught, that the existing `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` cases still match, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. I kept it as a permanent regression test; say if you'd rather not have it in the change.

The meta-generator pattern still requires a space after `"generator"` and the tag at the start of a line, as before. I didn't change that because it wasn't part of the typo list.
